```{r, annotation-host, echo = T}
# Reading and parsing the annotation file

#host gff file

  "https://ftp.ensemblgenomes.ebi.ac.uk/pub/protists/release-62/gff3/emiliania_huxleyi/Emiliania_huxleyi.Emiliana_huxleyi_CCMP1516_main_genome_assembly_v1.0.62.gff3.gz" |>
  read_tsv(comment = "#",
           col_names = FALSE,
           col_types = cols())
nrow(gff_host)
# if (FALSE) {
#   #run once
#   gff_host_newer <-
#     "https://ftp.ensemblgenomes.ebi.ac.uk/pub/protists/release-61/gff3/emiliania_huxleyi/Emiliania_huxleyi.Emiliana_huxleyi_CCMP1516_main_genome_assembly_v1.0.61.gff3.gz" |>
#     read_tsv(comment = "#",

#              col_types = cols())
#
#   (all.equal(gff_host, gff_host_newer))

# }

## restrict this to IDs in salmon files
salmon_files <- readRDS(paste0(base.path, "data/salmon_files_76samp.rds"))

salmon_df <-
  salmon_files |>
  map_df(read_tsv, .id = "sample_name", col_types = cols())

keep_these <- unique(salmon_df$Name)
remove(salmon_df, coldata, salmon_files)
length(keep_these) # 37781
# remove viral genes
table(grepl("^JF", keep_these))
keep_these_vir <- keep_these[grepl("^JF", keep_these)]
keep_these_host <- keep_these[!(grepl("^JF", keep_these))]
length(keep_these_host) #37334 (host genes)

gff_host |> 
  dplyr::filter(grepl("ID=transcript:", X9))  |> 
  nrow() #39798 update 12/2025: 38798

annot_host <-
  gff_host |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl("ID=transcript:", X9)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    locus_tag = str_extract(X9, "(?<=gene:)[^;]+"),
    #[^;]: one character that is not ";"
    tx_id = str_extract(X9, "(?<=ID=transcript:)[^;]+"),
    tx_name = str_extract(X9, "(?<=Name=)[^;]+"),
    tag = str_extract(X9, "(?<=tag=)[^;]+"),
    biotype = str_extract(X9, "(?<=biotype=)[^;]+")
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(locus_tag,
                tx_id,
                tx_name,
                biotype,
                tag,
                scaffold = X1,
                source = X2
                ) |>
  distinct(tx_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
nrow(annot_host) # 38798
gc()
#check
annot_host |> 
  group_by(tx_id) |> 
  tally() |> 
  dplyr::filter(n > 1) #0

annot_host |> 
  filter(tag=="Ensembl_canonical") |> 
  group_by(locus_tag) |> 
  count() |> 
  filter(n>1) #0
annot_host |> 
  group_by(locus_tag) |> 
  tally() |> 
  dplyr::filter(n > 1) |> 
  nrow() # 6/16/26: 9

annot_host |> 
  group_by(tx_name, .drop = F) |> 
  tally() |> 
  dplyr::filter(n > 1) |> 
  nrow() # 6/16/26: 31

#filter to keep only genes in salmon output
annot_host <- annot_host |> 
  dplyr::filter(tx_id %in% keep_these_host)
nrow(annot_host) # 37334
table(keep_these_host %in% annot_host$tx_id) #TRUE 37334
gc()
annot_host |> 
  group_by(locus_tag) |> 
  tally() |> 
  dplyr::filter(n > 1) |> 
  nrow() # 6/16/26: 9

annot_host |> 
  group_by(tx_name, .drop = F) |> 
  tally() |> 
  dplyr::filter(n > 1) |> 
  nrow() #22

#now continue
#check
(dup_annot <- annot_host |> 
    group_by(locus_tag) |> 
    tally() |> 
    dplyr::filter(n > 1) |> 
    pull(locus_tag)
) # 9 locus tags with more than one entry
#all locus_tags with more than one entry have distinct tx_names and tx_ids.

#the transcripts are still unique, good
annot_host |>
  dplyr::filter(locus_tag %in% dup_annot) |>
  group_by(tx_name) |>
  tally() |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1) #0
annot_host |>
  dplyr::filter(locus_tag %in% dup_annot) |>
  group_by(tx_id) |>
  tally() |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1) #0
# now check tx_name
(
  dup_annot2 <- annot_host |> 
    group_by(tx_name) |> 
    tally() |> 
    dplyr::filter(n > 1) |> 
    pull(tx_name)
)
#all cases of duplicated tx_name have unique locus_tags.
annot_host |>
  dplyr::filter(tx_name %in% dup_annot2) |>
  group_by(locus_tag) |>
  tally() |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1) #0
#add a column for easy filtering
annot_host <- annot_host |>
  mutate(UniqueLocusTag = case_when(
    locus_tag %in% dup_annot ~ FALSE,
    (locus_tag %in% dup_annot) == F ~ TRUE
  ))
annot_host |> 
  group_by(UniqueLocusTag) |> 
  tally() #false: 19, true: 37315

#what types of elements are in the gff
gff_host |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl("ID=transcript:", X9)) |>
  dplyr::select(X3) |>
  table()
annot_host |>
  group_by(biotype) |>
  tally() |>
  arrange(desc(n))

annot_host <- annot_host |>
  dplyr::select(locus_tag,
                tx_id,
                tx_name,
                biotype,
                UniqueLocusTag,
                everything())
table(annot_host$source)
nrow(annot_host) #37334
apply(annot_host, 2, function(x)
  length(unique(x)))
apply(annot_host, 2, function(x)
  sum(is.na(x))) #no NAs


cdna_host <-
  Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(
    "https://ftp.ensemblgenomes.ebi.ac.uk/pub/protists/release-62/fasta/emiliania_huxleyi/cdna/Emiliania_huxleyi.Emiliana_huxleyi_CCMP1516_main_genome_assembly_v1.0.cdna.all.fa.gz"
  ) |>

nrow(host_tib) #39599

nrow(host_tib) #37223

keep_these_host[!(keep_these_host %in% host_tib$tx_id)] #111 ncRNAs

)
nrow(host_tib2) #199 ncrna
#trim trailing white space
```

## Host ENA 
```{r, host-rna}
#remove pointless columns
host_ena<-"https://ftp.ensemblgenomes.ebi.ac.uk/pub/protists/release-62/tsv/emiliania_huxleyi/Emiliania_huxleyi.Emiliana_huxleyi_CCMP1516_main_genome_assembly_v1.0.62.ena.tsv.gz" |> 
  read_tsv(show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  dplyr::select(-c("species", "taxid"))
nrow(host_ena) # 38798
apply(host_ena, 2, function(x) length(unique(x)))
host_ena |> 
  dplyr::filter(protein_stable_id!=secondary_accession)
#remove pointless column
host_ena<-host_ena |> dplyr::select(-"secondary_accession")
apply(host_ena, 2, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
#rename
host_ena<-host_ena |> 
  dplyr::select(locus_tag = gene_stable_id,
                          tx_id = transcript_stable_id,
                          protein_id = protein_stable_id,
                          ENA_accession = primary_accession)
host_ena |> group_by(tx_id == protein_id) |> tally()
table(host_ena$tx_id %in% annot_host$tx_id)
#FALSE  TRUE 
# 1464 37334 
table(annot_host$tx_id %in% host_ena$tx_id)
#TRUE 
#37334 
#all host tx_ids are in this ena object. Good.
nrow(host_ena) #38798
length(keep_these_host) #37334
host_ena<-host_ena |> 
  dplyr::filter(tx_id %in% keep_these_host)
table(host_ena$tx_id %in% annot_host$tx_id)
# TRUE 
#37334 
nrow(host_ena) #37334
#check again
apply(host_ena, 2, function(x) length(unique(x)))
table(host_ena$locus_tag %in% annot_host$locus_tag)
table(annot_host$locus_tag %in% host_ena$locus_tag)
saveRDS(host_ena, file = paste0(base.path, "data/Annotations-host/ena-host.rds"))

write_tsv(host_ena, file=paste0(base.path, "data/Annotations-host/ena-host.tsv"))
## combine
annot_host2<-left_join(annot_host, host_ena,by = c("locus_tag", "tx_id")) 
annot_host2 |>
  dplyr::select(locus_tag, tx_id, tx_name, biotype, everything())
annot_host2<-annot_host2 |> 
  mutate(biotype = sub("_", "-", biotype))
annot_host2<-annot_host2 |> select(-scaffold)
tmp<-annot_host2 |> group_by(locus_tag) |> tally(name = "NrTranscripts")
annot_host2<-left_join(annot_host2, tmp)
annot_host2<-annot_host2 |> 
  arrange(locus_tag)
annot_host2<-annot_host2 |> 
  dplyr::select(tx_id, locus_tag, tx_name, protein_id, biotype, UniqueLocusTag, NrTranscripts, everything())

saveRDS(annot_host2,paste0(base.path, "data/Annotations-host/annot-host-ena.rds"))

write_tsv(annot_host2,paste0(base.path, "data/Annotations-host/annot-host-ena.tsv"))

temp<-as.data.frame(host_ena);
openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, sheetName = "ena")
openxlsx::writeData(wb, sheet = "ena", temp)
remove(temp);gc();getsizes()
```

## Combine ENA+NCBI+ensembl

```{r combine3}
## combine with ncbi_host
#remove(part1)
part1<-left_join(annot_host2 |> dplyr::filter(UniqueLocusTag==T), ncbi_annot3)
part1<-part1 |> mutate(IdenticalProts = NA, IdenticalTranscripts = NA)
part2 <-annot_host2 |> dplyr::filter(UniqueLocusTag==F)
#check
identical(sort(unique(part2$locus_tag)), dup_annot)
part3<-lapply(dup_annot, function(i){
  temp<-part2 |> dplyr::filter(locus_tag == i)
  temp2<-ncbi_annot3 |> dplyr::filter(locus_tag == i)
  #if(length(unique(temp2$length_prot))==1){
    cat(i, "\n")
  tempTxID<-str_extract(gff_host$X9[grepl(i, gff_host$X9)][grepl("Ensembl_canonical",gff_host$X9[grepl(i, gff_host$X9)])], "(?<=ID=transcript:)[^;]+")
  tempTxName<-str_extract(gff_host$X9[grepl(i, gff_host$X9)][grepl("Ensembl_canonical",gff_host$X9[grepl(i, gff_host$X9)])], "(?<=Name=)[^;]+")
  allProts<-paste0(temp2$refSeq_prot, collapse = ";")
  allNucs<-paste0(temp2$refSeq_nuc, collapse = ";")
  if(nrow(temp)==2){
  temp1b<-left_join(temp[1,], temp2) |> slice(1)
  temp2b<-left_join(temp[2,], temp2) |> slice(1)
  temp1b<-temp1b |> mutate(IdenticalProts = allProts, IdenticalTranscripts = allNucs)
  temp2b<-temp2b |> mutate(IdenticalProts = allProts, IdenticalTranscripts = allNucs)
  print(bind_rows(temp1b, temp2b))
  }else if(nrow(temp)==3){
  temp1b<-left_join(temp[1,], temp2) |> slice(1)
  temp2b<-left_join(temp[2,], temp2) |> slice(1)
  temp3b<-left_join(temp[3,], temp2) |> slice(1)
  temp1b<-temp1b |> mutate(IdenticalProts = allProts, IdenticalTranscripts = allNucs)
  temp2b<-temp2b |> mutate(IdenticalProts = allProts, IdenticalTranscripts = allNucs)
  temp3b<-temp3b |> mutate(IdenticalProts = allProts, IdenticalTranscripts = allNucs)
  print(bind_rows(temp1b, temp2b, temp3b))
  }
```

```{r, host-uniprot}
annot_harriet<-fread(paste0(base.path, "data/Annotations-host/harriet_emihu1_target_protein_annotations.tsv"),  fill=TRUE,na.strings = c("NA", '-'), sep = "\t", sep2 = ",") |> mutate(emihu1_protein=as.character(emihu1_protein))
dim(annot_harriet)
colnames(annot_harriet)
annot_harriet |> group_by(is.na(Preferred_name)) |> tally()
annot_harriet |>dplyr::filter(!(is.na(Preferred_name))) |> dplyr::select(Preferred_name, orthogroup)
#modify annot_host to merge
colnames(annot_host)
annot_host_ext<-annot_host |> 
  mutate(emihu1_protein=sub("EMIHUDRAFT_", "", gene_id), .before = gene_id)

annot_host_ext<-left_join(annot_host_ext, annot_harriet, by = "emihu1_protein")
annot_host_ext  |>dplyr::filter(!(is.na(Preferred_name))) |> dplyr::select(gene_symbol, Preferred_name)

#add gene names from harriet to annot_host_ext:

test<-annot_host_ext  |> 
  mutate(gene_symbol = case_when(is.na(Preferred_name) == F ~ Preferred_name, is.na(Preferred_name)==T ~ gene_symbol))
# check 
test |> group_by(is.na(gene_symbol)) |> tally()
# rename Description column from harriet and re-ordered columns
test<-test |> rename(description2=Description) |> dplyr::select(gene_symbol, description, description2, everything()) |> dplyr::select(-Preferred_name)

test<-test |> mutate(rowLabel = 
                case_when(is.na(gene_symbol)== F ~ gene_symbol,
                          is.na(gene_symbol)==T ~ gene_id),
              .after = "gene_symbol")



# change biotype to pseudogene based on harriet's annotation:
test |> group_by(biotype) |> tally() |> arrange(desc(n)) |> as.data.frame()
#          biotype     n
# 1  protein_coding 38554
# 2            tRNA   116
# 3            rRNA    63
# 4 tRNA_pseudogene    40
# 5           snRNA    10
# 6      pseudogene     5
# 7         SRP_RNA     4
# 8        misc_RNA     4
# 9           miRNA     2
test<-test |> 
  mutate(biotype = case_when(grepl("GEP_P", orthogroup)==T ~ "pseudogene", grepl("GEP_P", orthogroup)==F ~ biotype)) |> arrange(biotype)

#check
test |> group_by(biotype) |> tally() |> arrange(desc(n)) |> as.data.frame()
# 
#           biotype     n
# 1  protein_coding 38452
# 2            tRNA   116
# 3      pseudogene   107
# 4            rRNA    63
# 5 tRNA_pseudogene    40
# 6           snRNA    10
# 7         SRP_RNA     4
# 8        misc_RNA     4
# 9           miRNA     2
## host annotation with more features
annot_host_ext <- test |> 
  dplyr::select(rowLabel, gene_symbol, gene_id, transcript_id, description, description2, biotype, everything()) 
## write file
write_tsv(annot_host_ext, file = paste0(base.path, "data/annot_host_ext.tsv"))

## save files
write_tsv(annot_host, file = paste0(base.path, "data/annot_host.tsv"))
saverds(cdna_host, file = paste0(base.path, "data/cdna_host.rds"))
saverds(ncrna_host, file = paste0(base.path, "data/ncrna_host.rds"))
}
```

```{r, annot-host-alt2}
 dplyr::filter(n==1)|>
```
